note: South Platte NRD reservoir 8 mi W of Kimball off US-30 (264-acre lake at full pool). Sites are spread along open sandy shoreline tracks and a wooded west peninsula; the busiest stretch is the bare sand apron on the northeast shore by the boat docks. Two boat ramps, swimming beach. No target shooting; fires only in the district's fire pits. --Claude
summary: The South Platte NRD now owns and operates Oliver Reservoir: 48 fire-pit sites for tents or RVs plus overflow, free (donation $10-15), first come first served with kiosk registration, March 1 - October 31; written (site count 75 -> 48, review-based 25-ft limit cleared). Ownership should move from state to local and the NGPC park-permit line goes. Lake is at pool on both imagery dates and swimmable per 2026 weekly tests; campers on the NE shore sit on an open sand apron 15-40 m from the water, so lakefront stands.
